mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS on 20-day returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE on 5-day returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) on 60-day returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity that precedes an economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC for INDPRO on 20-day returns in late-cycle expansions is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL on 5-day returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS on 60-day returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1900 thousand units, it signals a robust housing market that supports consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1900, or the Rank IC for HOUST on 5-day returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a severe supply-side shock that disrupts corporate supply chains and reduces earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (INDPRO * GDPC1) on 60-day returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
